note: Closes 12 noon IST; payment closes 3 PM.

note: Payment facility closes 3 PM IST.

note: Closes 10 AM IST; locking starts 1 December, 4 PM.

title: Round 3 result
note: No resignation after joining; do not plan a later state switch.

note: All retained Round 1/2 Float seats also require physical reporting after Round 3.

note: Closes noon; payment closes 3 PM; eligibility restrictions apply.

note: Payment facility closes 3 PM IST.

title: Stray result
note: Join an allotted seat or forfeit security.

title: Stray reporting
note: Original documents and institute formalities required.

title: Joined Round 1 resignation cut-off
note: No exact separate cut-off established in the checked notices. Watch the live MCC resignation notice; do not substitute 2 November automatically.

note: Published window ended 4 PM IST; no CQ extension was found in the reviewed current MEDICAL PG notices.

note: To be notified separately by KNRUHS. National state-coordination dates are planning dates, not a local options portal opening.

title: CQ free-exit deadline
note: Requires the applicable KNRUHS phase/exit notice. No date invented from MCC rules.

note: Separate MQ application; closes 4 PM IST.

title: MQ merit, web options and reporting
note: To be notified separately. Registration alone is not submission of web options.

title: MQ exit / sliding window
note: Await the phase-specific notice; the prospectus’s late-discontinuation liability is not an exit schedule.

note: Live notice extended the original deadline. Latest checked deadline has passed.

note: Finish both application parts; payment alone is not a completed application.

title: Provisional merit list
note: Check your entry and subsequent correction notices.

note: Wait for the official allotment letter and check seat nature.

note: Closes 1 PM IST; schedule requests six copies.

note: NEFT/RTGS only; closes 3 PM IST. Follow Board account details on letter.

note: 9 AM–4 PM daily at allotted-college desk, Academic Block, SMS Medical College, Jaipur.
